_README: Fixture for scripts/retrieval_calibration.py, measuring THIS project's graph.
`nonsense` is copied VERBATIM from empirica-cortex's fixture (commit 255f79af) and
must stay that way. A regenerated floor jitters, and the whole point is that a run
today is comparable with a run last month — and with cortex's run on their graph.
Changing a nonsense query silently invalidates every prior number.
`probes` are artifacts of CERTAIN presence in core's own graph, matched on EXACT
artifact_id, never substring. `verbatim` reuses the finding's own distinctive
wording; `off` is how the question would actually arrive — deliberately sharing as
few content tokens with the artifact as the meaning allows, because that is the
case the measurement exists to expose.
To re-point at a different graph: keep `nonsense` untouched, replace `probes`.
nonsense: purple giraffe tessellation quarterly harmonica logistics
brindled cartography of unhurried tin whistle municipalities
sixteen lukewarm parabolas negotiating with a filing cabinet
the vestibular opinions of laminated weekday furniture
corrugated marmalade indexing for equestrian sundials
flotsam trigonometry beneath a wholesale accordion registry
unbuttoned meridians auditing the porcelain of last Tuesday
gelatinous semaphore franchise for reversible mountain paperwork
